data.name: Kumar
data.gender_notes: Kumar is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit kumāra, 'a young boy, prince, son'. Its root is Sanskrit kumāra (कुमार). A classical Sanskrit term; also a name of Kartikeya. Kumar is a Sanskrit name meaning “Prince; a young boy; son”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kumar expresses “Prince; a young boy; son”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit kumāra, 'a young boy, prince, son'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kumar total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
